claim_limits: provider-free fixture validity safety attribution and composition only
no live authority readiness entitlement cost quality superiority production delivery or runtime acceptance

functional_cases: normal checked write-all UNKNOWN fence exact bytes SHA file fsync exact readback and parent fsync
injected partial short write leaves a truncated nonauthoritative fence and NON_DURABLE_UNKNOWN
injected zero write is rejected on n<=0 and remains NON_DURABLE_UNKNOWN
write exception file-fsync exception readback exception and parent-fsync exception never report bytes SHA or durable
all failure cases remove the prior authoritative marker before attempting the fence and never claim PASS
source asserts checked loop zero-progress rejection exact readback before durability
